156	<body>
157	<div class="wrap">
158	  <h1>冒泡排序 · 动画演示</h1>
159	  <p class="sub">每一轮把相邻的两个元素两两比较，较大的往后“冒泡”，一轮结束后最大的元素就落到最终位置。</p>
160	
161	  <div class="layout">
162	    <div class="card">
163	      <div class="stage" id="stage"><div class="baseline"></div></div>
164	      <div class="status" id="status"></div>
165	      <div class="progress"><i id="progress"></i></div>
166	
167	      <div class="legend">
168	        <span style="--c: var(--bar)">未排序</span>
169	        <span style="--c: var(--compare)">正在比较</span>
170	        <span style="--c: var(--swap)">交换</span>
171	        <span style="--c: var(--sorted)">已归位</span>
172	      </div>
173	
174	      <div class="controls">
175	        <button class="primary" id="play">▶ 播放</button>
176	        <button id="prev">⏮ 上一步</button>
177	        <button id="next">下一步 ⏭</button>
178	        <button id="reset">↺ 重置</button>
179	        <button id="shuffle">🎲 随机数组</button>
180	      </div>
181	
182	      <div class="sliders">
183	        <label for="size">元素个数</label>
184	        <input type="range" id="size" min="5" max="30" value="12">
185	        <output id="sizeOut">12</output>
186	
187	        <label for="speed">播放速度</label>
188	        <input type="range" id="speed" min="1" max="10" value="5">
189	        <output id="speedOut">5</output>
190	      </div>
191	
192	      <div class="custom">
193	        <input id="customInput" placeholder="自定义数组，如：5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2">
194	        <button id="apply">使用</button>
195	      </div>
196	    </div>
197	
198	    <div class="card">
199	      <div class="stats">
200	        <div class="stat"><small>轮次</small><b id="statPass">0</b></div>
201	        <div class="stat"><small>比较</small><b id="statCmp">0</b></div>
202	        <div class="stat"><small>交换</small><b id="statSwp">0</b></div>
203	      </div>
204	      <pre class="code" id="code"></pre>
205	      <div class="hint">快捷键：<kbd>空格</kbd> 播放/暂停　<kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> 单步</div>
206	    </div>
207	  </div>
208	</div>
209	
210	<script>
211	const CODE = [
212	  'for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {',
213	  '  swapped = false',
214	  '  for (j = 0; j < n - 1 - i; j++) {',
215	  '    if (a[j] > a[j + 1]) {',
216	  '      swap(a[j], a[j + 1])',
217	  '      swapped = true',
218	  '    }',
219	  '  }',
220	  '  // a[n-1-i] 已归位',
221	  '  if (!swapped) break',
222	  '}',
223	];
224	
225	const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
226	const stage = $('stage');
227	let items = [];   // { id, v, el }
228	let steps = [];
229	let cur = 0;
230	let timer = null;
231	
232	// 预先生成全部步骤，这样可以前进/后退
233	function buildSteps(list) {
234	  const a = list.slice();
235	  const n = a.length;
236	  const out = [];
237	  const sorted = new Set();
238	  let cmp = 0, swp = 0, pass = 0;
239	  const push = s => out.push({ order: a.map(x => x.id), sorted: new Set(sorted), cmp, swp, pass, ...s });
240	
241	  push({ type: 'start', line: -1, msg: '初始数组，点击「播放」或「下一步」开始。' });
242	  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
243	    pass = i + 1;
244	    let swapped = false;
245	    push({ type: 'pass', line: 0, msg: `第 ${pass} 轮开始：从左往右比较到第 ${n - 1 - i} 个位置。` });
246	    for (let j = 0; j < n - 1 - i; j++) {
247	      cmp++;
248	      const gt = a[j].v > a[j + 1].v;
249	      push({
250	        type: 'compare', line: 3, j,
251	        msg: `比较 a[${j}] = ${a[j].v} 和 a[${j + 1}] = ${a[j + 1].v}：` + (gt ? `${a[j].v} > ${a[j + 1].v}，需要交换。` : '顺序正确，不交换。'),
252	      });
253	      if (gt) {
254	        [a[j], a[j + 1]] = [a[j + 1], a[j]];
255	        swp++;
256	        swapped = true;
257	        push({ type: 'swap', line: 4, j, msg: `交换！${a[j + 1].v} 向右移动一位。` });
258	      }
259	    }
260	    sorted.add(a[n - 1 - i].id);
261	    push({ type: 'settle', line: 8, msg: `第 ${pass} 轮结束，${a[n - 1 - i].v} 已到达最终位置。` });
262	    if (!swapped) {
263	      a.forEach(x => sorted.add(x.id));
264	      push({ type: 'early', line: 9, msg: '这一轮没有发生任何交换，说明数组已经有序，提前结束。' });
265	      break;
266	    }
267	  }
268	  a.forEach(x => sorted.add(x.id));
269	  push({ type: 'done', line: -1, msg: `🎉 排序完成！共 ${pass} 轮，比较 ${cmp} 次，交换 ${swp} 次。` });
270	  return out;
271	}
272	
273	function setData(values) {
274	  stop();
275	  stage.querySelectorAll('.bar').forEach(b => b.remove());
276	  items = values.map((v, id) => {
277	    const el = document.createElement('div');
278	    el.className = 'bar';
279	    el.innerHTML = `<span class="val">${v}</span><span class="ptr"></span>`;
280	    stage.appendChild(el);
281	    return { id, v, el };
282	  });
283	  steps = buildSteps(items);
284	  cur = 0;
285	  $('sizeOut').textContent = values.length;
286	  layout();
287	  render();
288	}
289	
290	function randomValues(n) {
291	  return Array.from({ length: n }, () => 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 95));
292	}
293	
294	function delay() {
295	  // 速度 1..10 → 1200ms..80ms
296	  const s = +$('speed').value;
297	  return Math.round(1200 * Math.pow(0.74, s - 1));
298	}
299	
300	// 根据舞台尺寸计算柱子宽高
301	function layout() {
302	  const W = stage.clientWidth;
303	  const H = stage.clientHeight - 32;
304	  const n = items.length;
305	  const slot = W / n;
306	  const bw = Math.max(4, slot * 0.72);
307	  const max = Math.max(...items.map(x => x.v));
308	  items.forEach(it => {
309	    it.el.style.width = bw + 'px';
310	    it.el.style.height = Math.max(6, (it.v / max) * H) + 'px';
311	    it.el.querySelector('.val').style.display = slot >= 22 ? '' : 'none';
312	    it.slot = slot;
313	    it.offset = (slot - bw) / 2;
314	  });
315	}
316	
317	function render() {
318	  const st = steps[cur];
319	  const dur = Math.min(450, delay() * 0.8);
320	  const byId = new Map(items.map(it => [it.id, it]));
321	
322	  st.order.forEach((id, idx) => {
323	    const it = byId.get(id);
324	    const el = it.el;
325	    el.style.transitionDuration = dur + 'ms';
326	    el.style.transform = `translateX(${idx * it.slot + it.offset}px)`;
327	    el.classList.remove('cmp', 'swp', 'done');
328	    const ptr = el.querySelector('.ptr');
329	    ptr.textContent = '';
330	
331	    if (st.sorted.has(id)) el.classList.add('done');
332	    if ((st.type === 'compare' || st.type === 'swap') && (idx === st.j || idx === st.j + 1)) {
333	      el.classList.remove('done');
334	      el.classList.add(st.type === 'compare' ? 'cmp' : 'swp');
335	      ptr.textContent = idx === st.j ? 'j' : 'j+1';
336	    }
337	  });
338	
339	  $('status').textContent = st.msg;
340	  $('statPass').textContent = st.pass;
341	  $('statCmp').textContent = st.cmp;
342	  $('statSwp').textContent = st.swp;
343	  $('progress').style.width = (cur / (steps.length - 1) * 100) + '%';
344	
345	  $('code').innerHTML = CODE.map((line, i) =>
346	    `<div class="${i === st.line ? 'hl' : ''}">${line.replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</div>`).join('');
347	
348	  $('prev').disabled = cur === 0;
349	  $('next').disabled = cur === steps.length - 1;
350	}
351	
352	function go(i) {
353	  cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(steps.length - 1, i));
354	  render();
355	}
356	
357	function tick() {
358	  if (cur >= steps.length - 1) { stop(); return; }
359	  go(cur + 1);
360	  timer = setTimeout(tick, delay());
361	}
362	
363	function play() {
364	  if (cur >= steps.length - 1) go(0);
365	  $('play').textContent = '⏸ 暂停';
366	  timer = setTimeout(tick, 150);
367	}
368	
369	function stop() {
370	  clearTimeout(timer);
371	  timer = null;
372	  $('play').textContent = '▶ 播放';
373	}
374	
375	$('play').onclick = () => timer ? stop() : play();
376	$('next').onclick = () => { stop(); go(cur + 1); };
377	$('prev').onclick = () => { stop(); go(cur - 1); };
378	$('reset').onclick = () => { stop(); go(0); };
379	$('shuffle').onclick = () => setData(randomValues(+$('size').value));
380	$('size').oninput = e => setData(randomValues(+e.target.value));
381	$('speed').oninput = e => { $('speedOut').textContent = e.target.value; };
382	
383	$('apply').onclick = () => {
384	  const vals = $('customInput').value
385	    .split(/[\s,，、]+/)
386	    .filter(Boolean)
387	    .map(Number)
388	    .filter(v => Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0);
389	  if (vals.length < 2) {
390	    $('status').textContent = '请输入至少 2 个正数，用逗号或空格分隔。';
391	    return;
392	  }
393	  const list = vals.slice(0, 40);
394	  $('size').value = Math.min(30, Math.max(5, list.length));
395	  setData(list);
396	};
397	$('customInput').addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') $('apply').click(); });
398	
399	document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
400	  if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
401	  if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); $('play').click(); }
402	  else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') $('next').click();
403	  else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') $('prev').click();
404	});
405	
406	window.addEventListener('resize', () => { layout(); render(); });
407	
408	setData(randomValues(12));
409	</script>
410	</body>
411	</html>
412

`<span class=\"prompt\">$ ./bubble_sort</span>\\n${escapeHtml(st.output)}`\n    : '<span class=\"prompt\">（排序完成后显示 main 的输出）</span>';\n\n  $('prev').disabled = cur === 0;\n  $('next').disabled = cur === steps.length - 1;\n}\n\nfunction go(i) {\n  cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(steps.length - 1, i));\n  render();\n}\n\nfunction tick() {\n  if (cur >= steps.length - 1) { stop(); return; }\n  go(cur + 1);\n  timer = setTimeout(tick, delay());\n}\n\nfunction play() {\n  if (cur >= steps.length - 1) go(0);\n  $('play').textContent = '⏸ 暂停';\n  timer = setTimeout(tick, 150);\n}\n\nfunction stop() {\n  clearTimeout(timer);\n  timer = null;\n  $('play').textContent = '▶ 播放';\n}\n\n$('play').onclick = () => timer ? stop() : play();\n$('next').onclick = () => { stop(); go(cur + 1); };\n$('prev').onclick = () => { stop(); go(cur - 1); };\n$('reset').onclick = () => { stop(); go(0); };\n$('shuffle').onclick = () => setData(randomValues(+$('size').value));\n$('size').oninput = e => setData(randomValues(+e.target.value));\n$('speed').oninput = e => { $('speedOut').textContent = e.target.value; };\n\n$('apply').onclick = () => {\n  const parts = $('customInput').value.split(/[\\s,，、]+/).filter(Boolean);\n  const vals = parts.map(Number);\n  if (vals.length < 2 || vals.length > 30 || !vals.every(v => Number.isInteger(v) && v > 0 && v <= 9999)) {\n    $('status').textContent = '请输入 2 到 30 个 1～9999 之间的正整数，用逗号或空格分隔。';\n    return;\n  }\n  $('size').value = Math.max(5, vals.length);\n  setData(vals);\n};\n$('customInput').addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') $('apply').click(); });\n\ndocument.addEventListener('keydown', e => {\n  if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n  if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); $('play').click(); }\n  else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') $('next').click();\n  else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') $('prev').click();\n});\n\nwindow.addEventListener('resize', () => { layout(); render(); });\n\nsetData(randomValues(10));\n</script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"

## assistant · 2026-11-04T04:03:50Z

妹妹，冒泡排序演示页面写好了，是 [bubble-sort-cpp.html](bubble-sort-cpp.html)，双击就能用浏览器打开。

- **左侧动画**：用柱状图演示排序过程。可以播放、暂停、单步前进或后退、重置、生成随机数组，也能调元素个数和速度，或者输入自己的正整数数组。快捷键是空格和左右方向键。
- **右侧 C++ 代码**：一个完整、能编译的程序，带行号和语法着色。每一步会高亮正在执行的那行，比如比较时高亮 `if (a[j] > a[j + 1])`，交换时高亮 `swap(...)`。
- **变量面板**：实时显示 `n`、`i`、`j`、`swapped`、`a[j]`、`a[j+1]` 的值，刚变化的变量会标出颜色。
- **程序输出**：`main` 里的数组会跟着当前数据变化，排完后显示程序的输出结果。

**验证情况：**
- 我在浏览器里跑了 53 组数组，最终结果都是正确的升序。逆序 9 个数是 8 轮、36 次比较、36 次交换；已经有序的数组跑 1 轮就会提前结束。
- 代码高亮的位置和变量数值一步一步核对过。输入非整数或 0 会被拒绝，并给出提示。
- 页面上的 C++ 代码用 `clang++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra` 编译没有警告，运行输出 `1 2 3 5 8 9`。
- 没有截图检查页面外观。

目录里原来的 `bubble-sort.html`（右侧是伪代码的版本）我没动。新页面按项目规则只放在本地，开发记录和对话归档已经提交并推送了（`0717873`、`02435d6`）。
